name: Paras Prints Solutions
tagline: A House of Total Solution of Printing Work & Corrugated Boxes
description: Since 1996, Paras Prints Solutions has gained immense expertise in manufacturing Corrugated boxes, Duplex boxes, Gift Boxes, Monocartons, Paper Bags, and Corporate Print Assets. Located strategically at B-8, B.S. Road Industrial Area, Ghaziabad (UP), we are recognized as one of the preeminent packaging manufacturers across North India.
introExtended: Our fully unified infrastructure houses end-to-end design, pre-press, high-speed 6-colour offset printing, automated corrugation, flute laminating, platen die cutting, and computerized quality testing under a single monitored roof.

differentiators.title: VIBRANT PRINTING
differentiators.sub: High-Impact Brand Printing — Sharp 6-Colour Komori Offset
differentiators.body: Photo-crisp graphics, gloss/matte lamination & spot UV that give your boxes a retail-ready luxury look.

differentiators.title: CRUSH-PROOF BOXES
differentiators.body: Engineered with high-burst virgin kraft paper to protect goods from rough handling and heavy warehouse stacking.

differentiators.title: QUALITY TESTED
differentiators.sub: Certified Quality & Safety — ISO 9001:2015 In-House Testing Lab
differentiators.body: Every batch is lab-tested for box bursting strength (BF), compression, drop shock, and moisture resistance.

differentiators.title: 1-STOP SHOP
differentiators.sub: End-to-End Packaging Service — From Custom Sample to Doorstep Delivery
differentiators.body: Get free CAD dieline box samples within 48 hours, direct factory pricing, and reliable bulk dispatch across India.

advantages.title: Estd. 1996
advantages.body: 28+ continuous years of print & corrugation engineering in Ghaziabad industrial cluster.

advantages.title: 100% In-House
advantages.body: Komori presses, single-facers, die-cutters, and Vijaya gluers under one single roof.

advantages.title: Print & Box Synergy
advantages.body: No finger-pointing between the printer and the box maker—we engineer both simultaneously.

advantages.title: Certified QA Lab
advantages.body: Scientific in-house measurement of Bursting Factor (BF), GSM weight, and paper moisture.

advantages.title: Rapid Prototyping
advantages.body: 24-hour CAD dielines and unprinted sample boxes delivered directly to your R&D department.

engineeringPillars.title: Automated Precision Die-Cutters & Creasers
engineeringPillars.body: Flawless crease-lines preventing fiber cracking along solid color prints, engineered for jam-free feeding in automated cartoning machines.

engineeringPillars.title: In-House Quality Testing Laboratory
engineeringPillars.body: Every batch tested for Cobb sizing, bursting factor (BF 18–35+), edge crush resistance (ECT), and digital paper moisture analysis.

engineeringPillars.title: Vendor-Managed Inventory (VMI) & JIT Dispatch
engineeringPillars.body: Dedicated buffer stock maintained at our Ghaziabad facility for rapid 48-hour Just-In-Time replenishment directly to your plant assembly lines.

capabilityHighlights.title: Full Integrated Capability
capabilityHighlights.body: From CAD sampling and graphic prepress to corrugation and finished supply.

capabilityHighlights.title: International Benchmarks
capabilityHighlights.body: Strict compliance with bursting strength, edge crush, and stack compression tests.

capabilityHighlights.title: Heavy In-House Machinery
capabilityHighlights.body: Multi-colour Komori Lithrone, Heidelberg Hybrid UV & automated folder-gluers.

capabilityHighlights.title: Custom Supply Chain Tailoring
capabilityHighlights.body: Engineered packaging tailored for electrical fixtures, appliances, FMCG, and automotive items.
